notes: New: a first save editor for Gen 3 games (Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald/FireRed/LeafGreen). Open a Gen 3 game and tap the tune icon in the top bar to edit your Money or Complete the Pokédex, written straight back to your .sav. It always backs up the original first and refuses to touch a save whose checksums don't validate — so reload it in your emulator to confirm. Verified end-to-end on a real Emerald save; more fields (items, badges, and a full Pokémon editor) are coming.
